ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, authorized signatories, and material counterparties against the OFAC SDN List, UK OFSI Consolidated List, UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Gibraltar Sanctions List, and Bermuda sanctions list. PEPs, including foreign PEPs, family members, and close associates, require enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds and source-of-wealth documentation, senior management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Adverse media checks and FATF country-risk rating are mandatory for the designated Low_Risk_Standard marine insurance surveyor profile.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.cross_border_entity_flag: The Bermuda Exempted Company is the ultimate corporate vehicle; the Gibraltar component operates as the licensed marine insurance surveyor service platform, requiring separate Gibraltar registration or continuation if commercial substance is established in Gibraltar.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Gibraltar Companies Registry / Companies House Gibraltar for any Gibraltar branch or continuation; Bermuda Registrar of Companies e-services for the Bermuda Exempted Company
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the controlling statutory language. All proposed names must use Latin/Roman script. Non-English words must be translated or transliterated into English and accompanied by certification where required. The Bermuda Exempted Company name must end in Limited, Ltd., or an approved abbreviation. Gibraltar filing name must not be misleading as to regulated status, and any insurance-related token requires prior Financial Services Commission authorization.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A written extension request must be submitted to the relevant Registrar before the reservation expires; extensions are generally granted in 30-day increments at the Registrar's discretion. Upon name rejection, the applicant may file a reconsideration request with the Registrar within 14 days, supplying the corrected name or the requisite regulatory consent. If the rejection is upheld, the aggrieved party may appeal to the Supreme Court of Gibraltar by way of judicial review or, for a Bermuda exempted company, petition the Bermuda Minister of Finance under the Companies Act 1981; sensitive-token refusals must be accompanied by prior authorization from the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission or Bermuda Monetary Authority.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not acceptable as the sole registered office for the Bermuda Exempted Company or for any regulated Gibraltar marine insurance surveyor operation. A physical registered office must be maintained in Bermuda at the licensed registered agent's address for the exempted company, and a separate physical service or registered office in Gibraltar must be maintained for the licensed surveyor activity. Virtual receptionist or telephony services may be used only as ancillary facilities.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: 20% probability of unannounced physical inspection during the first incorporation year, increasing to approximately 25% where the marine surveyor licence requires active commercial substance review. The Gibraltar Financial Services Commission and Bermuda Registrar of Companies each retain the right to conduct unannounced on-site inspections and demand access to books, records, and registered office premises.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Bermuda Companies Act 1981 (as consolidated and amended), applicable provisions ss. 4, 7A, 12, 13 and First Schedule; foreign branch registration under Gibraltar Companies Act 2014, Part 16 and s. 251
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda, Ministry of Finance, Hamilton; post-incorporation registration at Companies House Gibraltar under HM Government of Gibraltar
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1, Application for Licence to Commence Business as an Exempted Company; Form 2, Certificate of Incorporation; Gibraltar GCOMP-OR16 Overseas Company Registration
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the Exempted Company must maintain a Bermuda registered office and file annual government declarations. No formation escrow account is required, but insurance-related client funds must be held in a segregated escrow account in Gibraltar at a licensed bank or approved payment institution such as Wise.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the corporation adopt the name [Company] Limited and that the directors accept the unconditional share subscription of the initial subscriber; RESOLVED that the registered office in Bermuda be at the address of the Bermuda corporate service provider and that the registered agent be appointed for service of process; RESOLVED that John-Charles McAllister be appointed Chairperson, and Elena Voss as Managing Director, each to serve until the next Annual General Meeting; RESOLVED that the senior compliance officer open segregated sail-risk survey deposit accounts at Wise and Underwriter Wire-transfer clearing institutions; RESOLVED that all formation filings be transmitted to the Registrar and the Gibraltar branch registration be completed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda; eCompanies online filing portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a Name Reservation Request stating the proposed name ending in 'Limited' and declaring an exempted-status intention. Submit nationality and ownership particulars of future shareholders. The reservation will be preserved for 90 days.
required_dossiers: Form NM - Name Search and Reservation e-form
Description of the intended corporate object (ISIC 5222 maritime claims survey)
Identity and address proof of each subscriber or beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is considered to be confusingly similar to an existing register, propose a geographic qualifier or vowel-change and re-file; if still refused, submit a written appeal requesting Registrar's discretion and evidence of equivalence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bermuda Licenced Corporate Services Provider (registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The agent drafts the exempted-company Memorandum and Articles reflecting marine survey and claims-inspection powers, non-resident exempted-status language, and authorised share capital. Execute in English before a notary public in Bermuda or the subscriber's jurisdiction.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association
Subscriber's corporate approval or executed power of attorney
Certified passport and proof of residential address for each director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar objects to the object clauses, file a supplementary object-restatement via Form MO and execute an amending deed to narrow the permissible business scope.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of incorporation application and payment of statutory fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda; eCompanies portal with SWIFT fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete Form 1, attach the executed constitutional documents, signed registered-office consent, and evidence of payment of the USD 2,995 filing fee. Submit through the eCompanies portal with PDF/A dossiers, confirming the proposed commencement date is within 30 days.
required_dossiers: Form 1 - Application for Licence to Commence Business as an Exempted Company
Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certificate of Registered Office and Consent of Registered Agent
Wire transfer fee proof for USD 2,995
Consent-to-act of each first director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried by the Registry, respond within 14 calendar days via the portal with corrected capital figures and declarations; if rejected, a fresh application may be submitted within 21 days with corrected statutory disclosures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issue of Certificate of Incorporation and Exempted Status Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registrar issues Form 2, Certificate of Incorporation, and a separate Exempted Status Certificate. Verify the 'exempted company' wording and issue date, and arrange for original certificates to be couriered to the Bermuda registered office.
required_dossiers: Approved Form 1 application
Registry-issued Form 2 - Certificate of Incorporation
Exempted Status Certificate
Register of members and registered charge instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is delayed, submit an affidavit of urgency to the Companies Registry; if there is a typographical error, file Form C for certificate correction within 6 months without further fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First board meeting and formalisation of corporate governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered office in Bermuda; minutes certified by the Bermuda registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting with duly subscribed share capital and officer appointments. Adopt the pro-forma board resolution, issue share certificates, and file the Beneficial Ownership Declaration under Bermuda's Beneficial Ownership Act where applicable.
required_dossiers: Pro-forma First Board Resolution
Notice and minutes of the First Board Meeting
Register of Members and share ledger
Beneficial Ownership Declaration (Form BO)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an officer declines appointment, an ordinary resolution appoints a substitute; if minutes are challenged, a new certified minutes entry is filed under directors' affirmation and the original exhibits are preserved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration as an overseas company in Gibraltar
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies House Gibraltar; online filing through the Companies Bridge portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one month of Bermuda incorporation, file a certified copy of the Bermuda Certificate of Incorporation, a board resolution approving the Gibraltar branch, particulars of the Gibraltar branch manager, and a Gibraltar registered office address. Pay the Gibraltar registration fee of GBP 120.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Bermuda Certificate of Incorporation
Certified copy of the Exempted Status Certificate
Board Resolution approving the Gibraltar branch
Form GCOMP-OR16 - Overseas Company Registration
Consent of Gibraltar-resident process agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If Companies House issues a non-compliance notice, cure by submitting corrected particulars and paying the late filing fee; if registration is refused, appeal to the Supreme Court of Gibraltar under s. 251 of the Companies Act 2014.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Gibraltar Maritime Administration jointly with the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) for insurance claims-survey and marine inspection practice
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Marine Insurance Surveyor and Ship-Cargo Claims Inspector Operating Licence (Class 5222-3)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of the Environment, HM Government of Gibraltar
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 4 - Exempt / EIA Registration only; no full Environmental Impact Assessment required because the activity is office-based professional marine survey with no land-use change or emissions
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero industrial wastewater discharge to storm drains; VOC concentration below 5 mg/m3 in office air under Gibraltar Clean Air (VOC) Regulations 2019; survey vessels use only battery-powered instruments; waste handling must comply with the Gibraltar Waste Framework Directive Regulations 2011 and Port Waste Management Plan acknowledgement.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate issued by the Gibraltar Fire and Rescue Service; Structural Load Inspection Certificate for the registered office from the Gibraltar Building Control Authority; Commercial Buildings Occupancy Certificate including work-station ergonomic and emergency evacuation clearances; and Health and Safety Executive dockside walkway permit for port-call survey visits.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Income Tax Office (ITO), HM Government of Gibraltar, 8 Governor's Lane, Gibraltar GX11 1AA, acting under the Commissioner of Income Tax (Income Tax Act 2010) and the Gibraltar Customs & Border Agency (indirect tax and customs). Official filing and payment portal: HM Government of Gibraltar eServices (eservices.gibraltar.gov.gi), covering annual corporate self-assessment returns, notices of liability, economic substance returns, and Purchase Tax/customs declaration processes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1 - Company law registration: a Bermuda exempted company establishing a place of business in Gibraltar must register as an overseas company with the Registrar of Companies within one month of establishing the Gibraltar branch, delivering a certified copy of the Bermuda certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles, a Gibraltar registered-office address, and particulars of the local agent and directors. Step 2 - Tax registration: submit the Notice of Liability (Form C-G1) to the Income Tax Office disclosing the branch basis period, estimated Gibraltar-source profits, and the appointed Gibraltar-resident tax agent; the ITO then issues the Gibraltar Tax Reference Number (TRN), which must be quoted on all returns and payments. Step 3 - Ancillary registrations: register with the Customs & Border Agency for Purchase Tax when importing business equipment or supplies, and complete the annual Economic Substance Return (ESR) registration on the ITO portal once chargeable activity commences. Penalties apply for failure to notify chargeability within the period prescribed by the Commissioner.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (Bermuda parent layer: Tax_Exempt_Zone under the Bermuda Exempted Companies Act 1981, with exemption certificate valid until 2035 or 2050; Gibraltar branch layer: territorial charge on Gibraltar-source profits at the 12.5% standard corporation tax rate; no pass-through or tax-transparent election is available to corporations in Gibraltar).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Gibraltar has no check-the-box or classification election; companies are taxed at entity level. Available statutory elections: (a) group relief or loss-surrender election between Gibraltar-resident group companies (Income Tax Act 2010, sections 42-48); (b) election for the 2% preferential rate for qualifying regulated financial-services companies, restricted to licensed insurers, banks, and portfolio managers and therefore unavailable to an ISIC 5222 marine surveyor; (c) anti-hybrid elections under the Income Tax (Hybrid and Other Mismatch) Rules 2020 implementing ATAD; (d) optional alignment of the branch accounting period to the Gibraltar technical year of assessment running 1 July to 30 June; and (e) unilateral application to the Commissioner for revenue apportionment between survey work performed in Gibraltar territorial waters and work performed at foreign ports or on the high seas.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Gibraltar Purchase Tax regime (Purchase Tax Act 2015, as amended) - an import-stage consumption tax on goods entering Gibraltar, functionally distinct from EU VAT; services, including marine survey fees, are outside the scope of Purchase Tax. No VAT, GST, or sales-and-use tax is currently in force in Gibraltar; a draft VAT Act is forthcoming under UK-EU Trade and Cooperation Agreement alignment obligations but has not been enacted.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No economic-turnover threshold triggers Purchase Tax: the charge arises on the importation of goods at CIF value plus any customs duty, so all commercial importers must register with the Gibraltar Customs & Border Agency. For services, no indirect-tax registration arises because services are outside the Purchase Tax base. The draft future Gibraltar VAT contemplates a registration threshold in the region of EUR 10,000 for distance sales, but no such threshold is currently in force.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. Gibraltar does not mandate real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or PEPPOL BIS exchange. Purchase Tax is collected at customs clearance through the Gibraltar electronic declaration system (SAD/EAD), while corporate documentation such as invoices, survey certificates, and bank statements must be retained in original form for six years. No transition to EU continuous transaction controls is scheduled.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable as a VAT zero-rating: marine survey services are outside Gibraltar's Purchase Tax statute, so fees charged by the branch for vessel hull and cargo damage inspection, claims surveys, and reporting to overseas underwriters arise outside the scope of Gibraltar indirect tax and carry no output tax. Under the future Gibraltar VAT Act (not yet in force), supplies of marine surveying services connected to a vessel engaged in international voyages or to non-Gibraltar insured parties would qualify for zero-rating or export exemption, subject to documentary proof of the international transport nexus and primary evidence of the insured marine risk.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Gibraltar SAD C88 or electronic e-Export) where any goods-related costs are separately claimed as export-supported
Bill of Lading or original Sea Waybill (or Air Waybill) evidencing international movement of the surveyed vessel or cargo
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103 evidencing FX repatriation of the survey fee within 180 days
Signed Marine Survey Report (ISIC 5222 deliverable) identifying survey date, vessel IMO number, casualty particulars, and insured party
Underwriter settlement or policy document linking the survey mandate to the insured marine risk
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Misdeclarations, fraudulent export treatment, or abuse of Purchase Tax status attract: (i) under the Purchase Tax Act 2015, civil penalties up to 200% of the evaded tax, forfeiture of the goods, and up to seven years' imprisonment for fraudulent evasion; (ii) under the Income Tax Act 2010, assessment corrections on a six-year time limit, extended to twenty years for fraudulent or negligent returns, penalties up to 100% of the under-declared tax plus interest at the statutory rate of 8% per annum and potential criminal prosecution; and (iii) penalties under the Gibraltar Economic Substance rules for failure to substantiate the branch's activities. The Commissioner of Income Tax applies retrospective clawback of any zero-rating or refund benefit, together with surcharge, where the 180-day FX repatriation deadline is missed or the inward remittance certificate is false.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) as the prudential and AML/CFT supervisor for banking business in Gibraltar; Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) as the home-state regulator of the Bermuda Exempted Company; Bank of England as the monetary anchor for the Gibraltar pound (GIP), which is pegged 1:1 to GBP. Exchange control administration is fully liberalised: the United Kingdom repealed exchange controls in 1979 and Gibraltar maintains no separate exchange-control ministry or prior-approval apparatus.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility on both current and capital account. GIP is freely convertible into GBP at par, and GBP is concurrent legal tender in Gibraltar; USD and EUR conversion is freely available through the commercial banking system. The Bermuda Exempted Company enjoys statutory tax-exempt status and Gibraltar operates a territorial 10% corporation tax regime with exemption for qualifying non-resident activities, so profit remittance to ultimate shareholders attracts no withholding tax and no administrative dividend-blocking hurdles. Marine survey fees constitute current-account services revenue under ISIC 5222; remittance of such fees is unrestricted, absent sanctions exposure.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. Neither Gibraltar nor Bermuda imposes statutory timelines for export-proceeds surrender, mandatory conversion ratios, or repatriation deadlines. Marine cargo damage survey income is treated as fee-for-service export revenue; it may be retained in any freely convertible currency, held offshore, or hedged in accordance with the treasury policy. There is no central-bank reporting obligation for individual commercial payments, only standard suspicious-transaction and sanctions reporting under GFSC rules.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account with trade-finance and correspondent banking desk
Treasury and Capital Escrow Account (USD/EUR self-managed FX capabilities)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-High, conditional on genuine Gibraltar substance and transparent UBO disclosure. Wise Business supports GBP accounts for Gibraltar-licensed corporate clients and is expressly named in the target payment rails; Wise charges floating-rate FX, so only sub-USD 10,000 survey-fee disbursements are appropriate. Airwallex is viable for multi-currency collection and supplier payments. Revolut Business typically declines offshore tax-exempt vehicles. Legal constraint: UK FCA e-money licences do not extend to Gibraltar as a third country, so any EMI must hold a GFSC E-Money/IFI licence or operate solely as an unlicensed payment aggregator; a Bermuda Exempted Company without a Gibraltarian registered office and local director is generally rejected by licensed EMIs.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Gibraltar retail banks (GIB, Sabadell) require the physical attendance of at least one director at the commercial-banking branch in Gibraltar for wet-ink signing of the account mandate and board resolution; remote opening is generally unavailable for first-time offshore vehicles. Private banks (Turicum) may permit fully remote onboarding using video-call KYC, notarised apostilled constitutional documents, and a favourable banker's reference from an existing relationship bank. Digital EMIs allow 100% remote onboarding with a GFSC-registered agent and electronic ID verification, provided the Bermuda exempted company can evidence economic substance in Gibraltar.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore tax-exempt vehicle incorporated in Bermuda with nominee shareholding and historical bearer-share ambiguity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified extract of the Bermuda Registrar of Companies' UBO register; full chain of ownership declarations; signed Declaration of Trust in relation to any nominee shares; passport and proof-of-address for all natural-person UBOs; Gibraltar Economic Substance certificate evidencing local office, local director, employee payroll and marine-survey activity; two years of audited financial statements; professional-indemnity insurance certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk payment flows to marine claimants located in flag-of-convenience jurisdictions or sanctioned-port states
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Per-claim transaction file containing voyage charter-party, bills of lading, IMO vessel certificate, classification-society survey report, damaged-cargo survey report, P&I club cover note, sanctions-screening output, and written confirmation that the insured hull/cargo never entered OFAC, EU or UK-sanctioned waters.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt status triggers suspicion of profit diversion, round-tripping, or absence of commercial substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Gibraltar tax-residence confirmation and annual Economic Substance Act return; OECD transfer-pricing documentation applying arm's-length rates for intercompany survey fees; UK-Gibraltar double-taxation-agreement position paper; bank statements evidencing commensurate payroll, office rent and professional subscriptions; secondary GFSC tax-clearance correspondence; three-year commercial contracts with underwriters appointing the client as hull-cargo surveyor.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injection must route via SWIFT MT103 (individual transfers) or MT202 (bundled shareholder funding) from the parent bank to the Gibraltar account. Purpose-of-payment must state 'equity contribution to marine-survey operations' with ISO 20022 code EQUI for equity injection or INCR for capital increase; bank will additionally require a board resolution, shareholder-register excerpt, and source-of-wealth statement for any credit above EUR 10,000. No exchange-control approval is required; GIP is freely convertible and the funding envelope must reconcile with the subscribed capital declared in Bermuda company filings.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements use SWIFT MT103 with purpose codes CLAI (insurance claims), TRDP (trade-related payments), or SUPP (supplier payments). Domestic GBP disbursements clear through Faster Payments (up to GBP 1m) or CHAPS (same-day, unlimited); USD disbursements clear via Fedwire/CHIPS through Sabadell's or a third-party correspondent bank. Commercial Letters of Credit (documentary credits) govern subrogated hull-repair payments above USD 50,000; payments under USD 10,000 to surveyors, port agents, and loss adjusters may be executed via Wise API rails, reserving bank rails for underwriter remittances and claims settlements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanilla outright FX forwards (tenor up to 12 months) for GBP/USD and EUR/USD exposure arising from underwriter fee receivables and claim-disbursement liabilities
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) of no greater than 6-month tenor for restricted-currency exposures (e.g., RMB, IDR) encountered in Asian marine-claim settlements
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) solely for matching long-dated claim-trust funding periods of the Bermuda Exempted Company with its USD-denominated liabilities under the marine insurance policies

Plain-vanilla FX call/put options purchased from a GFSC-licensed counterparty; leveraged, barrier, and exotic options are expressly prohibited under the treasury mandate; all hedging instruments must be executed on a documented ISDA or master FX agreement with independent valuation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Gibraltar Income Tax Return (Company Return CT)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: HM Government of Gibraltar Income Tax Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 November following the end of the calendar tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly penalties up to 100% of tax liability plus interest; late payment interest accrues at 6% per annum.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Marine Insurance Surveyor Licence Annual Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal surcharge of £200; if unpaid for 30 days, license is suspended and commercial operations must cease.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Bermuda Registrar of Companies (via Bermuda Economic Development)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January following the calendar year of registration; thereafter annually
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties of BMD 100 per month; strike-off proceedings commence after six months' arrears.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of approval by shareholders; generally by 30 April for calendar-year entities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fines up to £5,000 for directors; civil penalties for non-compliance with audit requirements.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory audit required if (1) the entity is licensed by GFSC under the Insurance Act or associated regulations; (2) annual turnover exceeds GBP 2 million; (3) gross assets exceed GBP 1 million; (4) average employees exceed 10. Marine surveyor licensed entities are always subject to audit irrespective of thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by Gibraltar or FRS 102 (UK GAAP); accounts may be prepared in GBP, USD, or EUR.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually confirm the register of beneficial owners with the Gibraltar BOSS system, including any transfers of shareholding or changes in control since the last filing. The confirmation must accompany the annual return and be signed by a director or company secretary.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Persons with Significant Control (PSC Register)
Minute Book of Shareholder and Director Meetings

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Bermuda Exempted Company is tax-exempt in Bermuda. For Gibraltar tax purposes an effective 0% rate applies to foreign-source income if no Gibraltar-source trading profits arise and no permanent establishment exists; Gibraltar-source marine surveying fees are subject to the headline 12.5% rate. No statutory tax holidays exist for marine surveyors.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Gibraltar Company Tax Return Form CT-1 filed through the Gibraltar Income Tax Office e-Filing Portal (e-CT1)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than 12 months after the end of the chargeable accounting period; for a 31 December accounting period file by 31 December of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, Gibraltar company number and Bermuda exempted company number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Indicate 'Non-resident' and supply the Bermuda certificate of incorporation and certificate of exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gibraltar registered office address and local agent contact.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State whether the office is merely an administrative letterbox; provide the agent’s licence number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Location where board meetings are held and key strategic decisions are made.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach minutes evidencing Bermuda or third-country management; if management occurs in Gibraltar, declare tax residence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross survey and inspection fees attributable to marine insurance claims in Gibraltar.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter nil if no clients are physically visited in Gibraltar; otherwise calculate fees from vessel hull/cargo inspections performed in Gibraltar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Salaries, drydocking access, marine survey equipment, professional indemnity insurance, travel, and AML compliance costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Limited to expenses exclusively incurred for producing Gibraltar-source income; non-attributable overheads are disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Chargeable profits after applicable allowances multiplied by 12.5%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Where Box 4 is nil and no taxable presence exists, enter zero and submit detailed source narrative.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: initial GIP 100, then GIP 50 per day up to GIP 5,000. Understated tax through negligence: penalty of 50% of the deficiency; deliberate understatement: 100% of the deficiency, plus interest at 1% per month.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No comprehensive double taxation agreement exists between Gibraltar and Bermuda. A shareholder of a Bermuda Exempted Company seeking unilateral relief from any residual Gibraltar charge must submit a Gibraltar Income Tax Certificate of Residence (TRC), a Form DWT-1 claim identifying the beneficial owner, and documentary ownership trail from Bermuda. Approval is issued by the Commissioner of Income Tax within 30 days of complete submission.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT: 0% for royalties and 0% for interest paid by a Gibraltar company to non-residents. The EU Savings Directive legacy interest withholding mechanism has been repealed; no DTA-reduced rate is relevant for Bermuda recipients.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File required where annual Gibraltar turnover exceeds GIP 10,000,000 or controlled transactions with the Bermuda parent exceed GIP 1,000,000. Master File required for groups with aggregate worldwide turnover exceeding GIP 50,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Yes. Marine insurance surveying falls within the relevant activity of 'Insurance' and 'Distribution and Service Centers'. The Bermuda Exempted Company must maintain at least two board meetings per year in Gibraltar, employ locally qualified surveyors and administrative staff, keep physical premises or recorded operational assets, and perform core income-generating activities in Gibraltar. Failure to satisfy economic substance creates a rebuttable presumption of tax evasion and a classification as a shell company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission of vessel hull and cargo inspection fees earned during client meetings and site inspections in Gibraltar, while relying on the Bermuda tax exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Additional assessment at 12.5% plus a penalty of 200% of the tax evaded, a criminal fine of up to GIP 500,000, and imprisonment for up to 7 years. Orders for asset forfeiture may be issued.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable under s.218 Income Tax Act for unpaid corporate tax, disqualified from board service for up to 15 years, and made subject to court-imposed travel bans preventing departure from Gibraltar.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a Bermuda Exempted Company with no physical office, no employees, and no substantive activity in Bermuda or Gibraltar, used exclusively to route marine claim fees away from taxation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off from the Gibraltar Register of Companies, cancellation of the Bermuda exemption certificate, and administrative penalty of GIP 50,000 per year of non-compliance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Director assets may be frozen by court order; directors receive a 10-year prohibition from acting as director of any company registered in a British Overseas Territory or Crown Dependency; civil liability for resulting tax deficiencies.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving Underwriter Wire or Wise payments from marine claims without performing customer due diligence, source-of-funds checks, or sanctions screening of vessel owners, insurers, and cargo beneficiaries.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Unlimited fines under the Proceeds of Crime Act (Gibraltar) and the AML/CFT Regulations, seizure of all transaction proceeds, and imprisonment up to 14 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be prosecuted for money laundering and receive a personal civil penalty of GIP 100,000; they may be barred from fiduciary positions and subject to Personal Liability Orders for unpaid confiscation amounts.
